name: PvE Power and PvP Power stack against creatures in the High-Risk open world
contract: Requires PvePower.Enable = 1 and PvpPower.Enable = 1. A level 60 player wearing PvP Power +42 (chestpiece) and PvE Power +38 (trousers) deals 1.021 x 1.019 and takes 0.979 x 0.981 of the base damage against a creature in the High-Risk open world. Outside High Risk only PvE Power applies.

steps.label: Outside High Risk only PvE Power +38 raises damage dealt
Outside High Risk only PvE Power +38 lowers damage taken
In High Risk the two powers multiply on damage dealt
In High Risk the two powers multiply on damage taken
